meanings.usage: 指不认识的人或不太熟悉的人
表示被动地收到某物，如信件、礼物等

meanings.meaning: 女儿（指女性后代，与son（儿子）相对）

meanings.usage: dream of doing something 表示梦想做某事
travel的现在分词形式，表示正在进行的动作
通常指玻璃或塑料容器，这里指装纸条的瓶子
表示有规律地、频繁地做某事
throw into 表示扔进某处

phrases.usage: 表示从未想过、从不敢想，用于强调意外或惊讶

examples.en: She never dreamed of winning the lottery.

phrases.usage: 把...放入...，表示将东西放进容器或地方

examples.en: He put the letter into the envelope.

phrases.usage: 把...扔进...，强调动作的方向性

examples.en: She threw the bottle into the sea.
I often think of my childhood.
I write to my parents every week.

phrases.usage: 决定做某事，表示经过思考后做出选择
多一点，修饰不可数名词或形容词比较级

examples.en: I need a little more time.

phrases.usage: 十个月后，表示过去某个时间点之后的时间

examples.en: He left home, and ten months later he returned.
examples.zh: 他离开了家，十个月后他回来了。

phrases.usage: /pəʊst ˈɒfɪs/ noun phrase. 邮局（指寄送信件和包裹的机构）

grammar.title: 一般过去时（Simple Past Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个特定时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情，如故事、经历、历史事件等

examples.en: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel.
examples.zh: 去年，我们正在穿越英吉利海峡。

examples.en: She threw the bottle into the sea.
Ten months later, she received a letter.
examples.zh: 十个月后，她收到了一封信。

grammar.title: 一般将来时（Simple Future Tense）
grammar.structure: 主语 + will + 动词原形 / 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示将来要发生的动作或存在的状态 用于预测、计划、承诺等将来发生的事情

examples.en: Letters will cost a little more.

grammar.title: 过去进行时（Past Continuous Tense）
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing形式
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 用于描述故事发生的背景或正在进行的动作

examples.en: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel.
examples.zh: 去年，我们正在穿越英吉利海峡。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + never thought of + doing something

original.en: She never thought of it again.
original.zh: 她再也没想过这件事了。

imitations.en: I never thought of giving up.
He never thought of asking for help.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + receive(d) + something + from + 地点/人物

original.en: She received a letter from a girl in Holland.
original.zh: 她收到了一封来自荷兰女孩的信。

imitations.en: I received a gift from my friend.
imitations.zh: 我收到了朋友的一份礼物。

imitations.en: She received a call from her mother.
imitations.zh: 她接到了她妈妈的来电。

patterns.pattern: Both + 主语 + 动词 + to each other regularly

original.en: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
original.zh: 现在两个女孩定期互相写信。

imitations.en: They talk to each other regularly.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has decided to + 动词原形

original.en: They have decided to use the post office.

imitations.en: She has decided to study abroad.
We have decided to start a business.

lines.en: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
lines.zh: 我的女儿简从未想过会接到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信。

lines.en: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.
lines.zh: 去年，当我们横渡英吉利海峡时，简把写有她姓名和住址的一张纸条装进了一只瓶子，又将瓶子扔进了大海。

lines.en: She threw the bottle into the sea.
lines.zh: 此后她就再没去想那只瓶子。

lines.en: She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
lines.zh: 但10个月以后，她收到了荷兰一位姑娘的来信。

lines.en: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
lines.zh: 现在这两位姑娘定期通信了。

lines.en: However, they have decided to use the post office.
lines.zh: 然而她们还是决定利用邮局。

lines.en: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
lines.zh: 这样会稍微多花点钱，但肯定是快得多了。

questions.q: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
questions.zh: 简是怎样收到一位陌生人来信的？
questions.a: Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle and threw it into the sea while they were travelling across the Channel. Ten months later, a girl in Holland found it and wrote to her.
questions.aZh: 简把写有姓名住址的纸条装进瓶子，横渡英吉利海峡时扔进大海；十个月后，荷兰的一位姑娘捡到瓶子并给她写了信。
questions.hint: 见第 2、4 句：threw the bottle into the sea; received a letter from a girl in Holland。

questions.q: What did Jane put into the bottle before she threw it into the sea?
questions.zh: 简把什么装进了瓶子，然后扔进大海？
questions.a: She put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into the bottle.
questions.aZh: 她把一张写有自己姓名和住址的纸条装进了瓶子。
questions.hint: 第 2 句：a piece of paper with her name and address on it。

questions.q: What does 'the Channel' mean here, and why is the past continuous tense used in 'we were travelling across the Channel'?
questions.zh: 文中的 the Channel 指什么？为何用过去进行时 were travelling？
questions.a: The Channel means the English Channel. The past continuous 'were travelling' describes the longer background action, while the past simple 'put' and 'threw' describe the short actions that happened.
questions.aZh: the Channel 大写指英吉利海峡。过去进行时表示持续的背景动作，一般过去时表示其间发生的短暂动作。
questions.hint: 讲义注：过去进行时表背景，一般过去时表动作。

questions.q: Why have the two girls decided to use the post office instead of a bottle?
questions.zh: 为什么两位姑娘决定改用邮局，而不再用瓶子？
questions.a: Because letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster than a bottle drifting across the sea.
questions.aZh: 因为信件虽然会稍微多花点钱，但肯定比海上漂瓶快得多。
questions.hint: 见末两句：decided to use the post office; cost a little more, travel faster。

questions.q: If you were Jane, would you still throw a bottle into the sea? Why?
questions.zh: 如果你是简，你还会把瓶子扔进海里吗？为什么？
questions.a: I would throw it just for fun, but I would not rely on it, because the sea is uncertain: the bottle may never be found, while the post office is quick and reliable.
questions.aZh: 我会为了好玩而扔，但不会指望它，因为大海充满偶然，瓶子可能永远没人捡到；邮局更快也更可靠。
questions.hint: 结合 travel faster 与故事结局。

translation:
我的女儿简从未想过会接到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信。
去年，当我们横渡英吉利海峡时，简把写有她姓名和住址的一张纸条装进了一只瓶子，又将瓶子扔进了大海。
此后她就再没去想那只瓶子。
但10个月以后，她收到了荷兰一位姑娘的来信。
现在这两位姑娘定期通信了。
然而她们还是决定利用邮局。
这样会稍微多花点钱，但肯定是快得多了。
title: A glass envelope
subtitle: 玻璃信封

lead.question: 一只漂在海上的瓶子，怎样让两个素不相识的女孩成了笔友？
lead.warmup: 在即时通讯普及之前，一封跨国来信往往要漂洋过海、辗转数周。本课中，简把写着姓名住址的纸条塞进瓶子，扔进英吉利海峡；十个月后，她竟收到了荷兰一位同龄女孩的回信。那只漂流的瓶子成了她们的第一只“玻璃信封”，而故事最后又回到了邮局。
goals: 掌握 dream of、think of、receive from、decide on 等“动词 + of/from/on”固定搭配
理解过去进行时作背景、一般过去时表示动作的时间关系
学会 both、each other、of her own age、travel across 等本课重点表达
能复述“漂流瓶通信”的故事，并用英文比较两种通信方式的优劣
lead.summary: 全文按时间推进：简从未想过会收到同龄荷兰女孩的来信，去年横渡英吉利海峡时投瓶入海，十个月后收到回信，如今两人定期通信却决定改走邮局——信稍贵，但一定更快。写法上，were travelling 作背景，put、threw、received 推进情节。
lead.tips: 易错：dream of、think of 后接动词必须用动名词；throw 后接 into 而非 in；cost 的过去式仍是 cost，不能写成 costed。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我的女儿简从未想过会接到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信。
exercises.a: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
exercises.note: dream of + 动名词；of her own age 作后置定语。

exercises.q: 填空：Last year, we were travelling ______ the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper into a bottle.
exercises.note: travel across 横跨；大写 the Channel 指英吉利海峡。

exercises.q: 改错：She threw the bottle in the sea.
exercises.a: She threw the bottle into the sea.

exercises.q: 句型转换（用 both of 改写，句意不变）：Both girls write to each other regularly now.
exercises.a: Both of the girls write to each other regularly now.
exercises.note: both 后可加 of；each other 作宾语。

exercises.q: 填空：She never thought ___ it again, but ten months later she received a letter ___ a girl in Holland.
exercises.note: think of、receive...from 均为固定搭配。

exercises.q: 汉译英：然而她们还是决定利用邮局。这样会稍微多花点钱，但肯定是快得多了。
exercises.a: However, they have decided to use the post office. Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
exercises.note: decide to do；cost 主语通常为物。

exercises.q: 改错：The dress costed me twenty pounds.
exercises.a: The dress cost me twenty pounds.
exercises.note: cost 过去式仍为 cost，不可加 -ed。

quiz.q: 课文标题中的 “a glass envelope” 实际上指的是什么？
options: The bottle Jane threw into the sea
An envelope made of glass paper
The window of the post office
A glass box for keeping stamps
quiz.note: 纸条装在瓶子里，瓶子就是那只“玻璃信封”。

quiz.q: 简扔进海里的瓶子里装的是什么？
options: A photo of her family
A piece of paper with her name and address on it
A long letter to a Dutch girl
A small glass envelope
quiz.note: 第 2 句：a piece of paper with her name and address on it。

quiz.q: “never dreamed of receiving” 中，dreamed of 后面应接哪种形式？
options: receive（动词原形）
to receive（不定式）
receiving（动名词）
received（过去式）
quiz.note: dream of 后接动名词，of 不可省略。

quiz.q: 课文中 “She threw the bottle ___ the sea.” 空白处应填哪个介词？
options: in
at
on
into

quiz.q: “a girl of her own age” 中的 of her own age 是什么意思？
options: A girl as old as Jane
A girl older than Jane
A girl from Jane's own school
A girl who lives by herself
quiz.note: of one's own age 意为“与某人同龄的”。

quiz.q: 两位姑娘为什么最终决定改用邮局寄信？
options: Because a bottle is too expensive to buy
Because letters cost a little more but travel much faster
Because the sea is too far away
Because they no longer write to each other
quiz.note: 末句：cost a little more, but certainly travel faster。
